scheme_name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance in the Form of Grant-In-Aid to Bhajani/ Choir/ Cultural Group/ Institutions for Purchase of Musical Instruments
other_conditions: The Mandal/Group/Institution/Troupe must consist of at least 10 members.
The Mandal/Group/Institution/Troupe must be conducting regular musical performances such as bhajans, choir singing, folk performances, etc.
The Mandal/Group/Institution/Troupe must not have already received the benefits of this scheme.
benefits_summary: Lumpsum grant up to ₹15,000 per group/institution for purchasing musical instruments.
